definition.en: The capability of a draft to make the garment SMALLER than the body and let the knit stretch to fit — the fit strategy of every close knit, from a bodysuit to a swim brief. It is the deliberate opposite of ease: the fabric supplies the missing girth, and the fit is a tension rather than a clearance.
definition.es: La capacidad de un trazo de hacer la prenda MÁS PEQUEÑA que el cuerpo y dejar que el punto se estire hasta ajustar — la estrategia de ajuste de todo tejido de punto ceñido, del body a la braga de baño. Es lo contrario deliberado de la holgura: la tela aporta el contorno que falta y el ajuste es una tensión, no un margen.
definition.fr: La capacité d'un tracé à faire le vêtement PLUS PETIT que le corps et à laisser la maille s'étirer pour aller — la stratégie d'ajustement de tout tricot près du corps, du body au bas de maillot. C'est l'inverse délibéré de l'aisance : le tissu fournit le tour qui manque, et l'ajustement est une tension, non un jeu.
definition.pt: A capacidade de um traçado tornar a peça MAIS PEQUENA do que o corpo e deixar a malha esticar até assentar — a estratégia de ajuste de todo o tricô justo, do body à cueca de banho. É o contrário deliberado da folga: o tecido fornece o perímetro que falta e o ajuste é uma tensão, não uma margem.

aliases.name: knit_negative_ease
aliases.note: hyperobject.capabilities key; declared by 119 cartridges and true on 41 as of 2026-09-02. The canonical spelling.

aliases.name: negative_ease_knit
aliases.note: The same claim with the words reversed, on 12 cartridges (11 true) — the largest near-duplicate pair in the capability tail, and the reason the capability vocabulary exists.

constraints: Negative ease is only legitimate against a DECLARED stretch: the reduction has to come out of the fabric card's measured stretch percentage, and the same reduction cut in a woven is a garment nobody can put on.
notes: One cartridge (kids-t-shirt) declares the opposite, `knit_positive_ease` — a knit deliberately drafted with room. It is a different claim, not a misspelling of this one.
